Name: Otter style horses for Mizu's Unicorn and Friends
Author: Sajiri
Description:
Here it is, finally finished my retexture. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Otterlyadorable?gameId=1303]OtterlyAdorable[/url] graciously gave me permission to share this mod, and I will give a full disclaimer that I used some of their horses for the base of the adult horse sprites in this mod.


[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
Drop the assets folder directly into the install folder for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47474]Mizu's Unicorn and Friends [color=#ffffff]and overwrite files as needed. ([/color][/url][color=#ffffff]sorry, I dont know how to make CP mods)[/color]



[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/47474]Mizu's Unicorn and Friends, obviously[/url]
Not required but heavily recommended is [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15621]Otter's Horse mod[/url] for matching rideable  horses. If you like this mod, please go endorse Otter's horses, as this wouldnt exist without Otter's lovely sprites.



Please note I havent tested every horse in game, so there may be some issues with rogue pixels. Let me know of anything you see and I will try to fix it as needed
